'''LSJK Every DS Deck Watch Your Step''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[LSJK]]
* '''Published:''' 7 July 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Podrace Prep|Tat-L-podraceprep.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Watch Your Step
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed WYS LSJK LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Leebo: no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

I know I'm not the first one to do this but this deck kills. This deck has to be one of the strongest decks (except ROPs before Ounee Ta) ever because it's a bunch of crap that wins everytime.

== Notes ==

* Posted 'Tatooine (Coruscant)' dested Tatooine; the starting cards include the podrace package (Podrace Prep, Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace).

== Strategy ==

This deck is all about multiple high battle destiny draws.  Avg destiny = 4 so you wil do good in any battle.  If they battle the Falcon play Out Of Nowhere and Punch It and you get 6 Battle Destinies and you're immune to attrition.  First tunr you can usually get a starship or pilot in your hand so deploy Kessel and that ship and force drain for three for the entire game unless the Dark Side is dumb enoug hto go there and get the crap beat out of them.  You are garunteed to win the Podrace even against Sebulba so you retireve 6 and the nplay I Did It! and you're set.  Make your Kessel Runs from Ralltiir with Ralltiir Frieghter Captians becasuse you retieve 10 Force.  Place every lost card of the Dark Side out of play with the 6 Out Of Commissions.  I'll Take The Leader pretty much makes all the starships immune to attrition <7 so good luck killing them.  The best comination is Tatooine and Ralltiir because you can move there as a react for free.  Ralltiir also lets you spread out thinner.  Almost any system can be contolled by just a ship, thier matching pilot and a Ralltiir Freighter Caption so don't stack everything in one place.

There are only a couple things to watch for:

Guri-you only get one battle destiny

Grabbers-if they use these DON'T play you interrupts they are too valuable as 5's and 6's, just lose them and retrieve them.

Vitual Bossk-only one battle destiny

Wipe Them Out All Of Them-only two battle destinies where you have a Ralltiir Freighter Captain
